I have implemented type-safe SQL window function helpers, frame specifications, and named window definitions across all supported dialects on branch `feat/window-functions`:

### Summary of Changes

1. **Window Function & Frame Helpers ([window.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts), exported via [index.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/index.ts))**
   - **Ranking helpers**: [`rowNumber`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L254-L256), [`rank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L258-L260), [`denseRank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L262-L264), [`ntile`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L266-L271), [`percentRank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L273-L275), [`cumeDist`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L277-L279).
   - **Offset / value-access helpers**: [`lag`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L306-L333), [`lead`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L335-L362), [`firstValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L364-L371), [`lastValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L373-L380), [`nthValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L382-L393). Value-access helpers infer nullable return types (`T | null`) and strip `null` when a non-null default is passed to `lag` or `lead`.
   - **Window aggregates**: [`windowSum`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L395-L397), [`windowAvg`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L399-L401), [`windowMin`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L403-L410), [`windowMax`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L412-L419), [`windowCount`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L421-L423) (emitting `count(*)` when called without arguments).
   - **Frame utilities & boundaries**: [`rows`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L136-L139), [`range`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L141-L144), [`unboundedPreceding`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L76), [`currentRow`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L77), [`unboundedFollowing`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L78), [`preceding`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L80-L85), and [`following`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L87-L92).
   - **Builder & Validation**: [`WindowFunction.over`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L221-L227) accepts an inline [`WindowSpec`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L146-L150) (`partitionBy`, `orderBy`, `frame`), a named window string (compiling to `over "name"`), or no arguments (compiling to `over ()`). Numeric positional arguments are emitted via `sql.raw` so they never become bound parameters.

2. **Dialect Select Builders & SQL Compilation**
   - Added chainable `.window(name, spec)` and `WINDOW` clause generation prior to `ORDER BY` across:
     - PostgreSQL ([select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/pg-core/query-builders/select.ts), [select.types.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/pg-core/query-builders/select.types.ts), [dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/pg-core/dialect.ts))
     - MySQL ([select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/mysql-core/query-builders/select.ts), [select.types.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/mysql-core/query-builders/select.types.ts), [dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/mysql-core/dialect.ts))
     - SQLite ([select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/sqlite-core/query-builders/select.ts), [select.types.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/sqlite-core/query-builders/select.types.ts), [dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/sqlite-core/dialect.ts))
     - SingleStore ([select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/singlestore-core/query-builders/select.ts), [select.types.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/singlestore-core/query-builders/select.types.ts), [dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/singlestore-core/dialect.ts))
     - Gel ([select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/gel-core/query-builders/select.ts), [select.types.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/gel-core/query-builders/select.types.ts), [dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/src/gel-core/dialect.ts))

3. **Tests**
   - Added unit and type tests in [window-functions.test.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ko0i2yep/drizzle-orm/tests/window-functions.test.ts) covering SQL compilation, parameter binding, boundary/argument validation, multi-dialect `.window()` clauses, and TypeScript return type inference.
